Full-Stack Engineering Assessment
Overview
The AI Travel Planner is a web application that allows users to generate a complete travel itinerary using an LLM agent. Users provide travel details such as destination, number of days, interests, and budget. The AI agent generates a day‑by‑day travel plan along with an estimated budget for the trip. Users can also modify the itinerary dynamically.
Preferred Tech Stack
The preferred tech stack for this assessment is:
Frontend: Next.js + Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js + Express
Database: MongoDB
Language: JavaScript or TypeScript
Application Overview
Build a multi-user trip planner where:
Users can register and log in
Each user has a personalized dashboard
Accept travel details from the user
Generate a structured itinerary using an LLM
Estimate the trip budget
Allow itinerary modification
Suggest hotels for the destination
The application must support multiple users with strict data isolation.
Core Requirements
1. Authentication & Authorization
Secure user authentication
Authorization enforced across the application
Protected access to user-specific features
Users must not be able to access or modify other users’ data
2. Trip Input Form
Users provide:
Destination
Number of days
Budget type (Low / Medium / High)
Interests (Food, Culture, Adventure, Shopping, etc.)
3. AI Itinerary Generator
The LLM agent generates a day‑by‑day itinerary based on user inputs.
Example Output:
Day 1
Visit Senso‑ji Temple
Explore Asakusa street food
Day 2
Tokyo Skytree
Akihabara shopping
4. Budget Estimation
The AI agent estimates the overall travel cost based on:
Destination
Number of days
Budget preference
Typical travel costs
Example:
Estimated Budget:
Flights: $400
Accommodation: $300
Food: $150
Activities: $100
Total Estimated Budget: $950
5. Editable Itinerary
Users should be able to:
Remove an activity
Add a new activity
Regenerate a specific day
Example request:
"Regenerate Day 3 with more outdoor activities"
6. Bonus Feature
Hotel Suggestions
The AI agent suggests hotels based on:
Destination
Budget
Popular traveler ratings
Example:
Recommended Hotels:
• Hotel Sakura Tokyo – Budget Friendly
• Shinjuku Grand Hotel – Mid Range
• Tokyo Imperial Palace Hotel – Luxury
7. Frontend Requirements
Build the UI using Next.js
Style the application using Tailwind CSS (or equivalent if stack is changed)
Create reusable and readable components
Focus on good UX, accessibility, and responsiveness
8. Backend Requirements
Implement a backend using Node.js (or equivalent if stack is changed)
Handle errors gracefully
Enforce authorization consistently
Write scalable, maintainable, and readable code
9. Code Quality
Use JavaScript or TypeScript only
Follow clean architecture and separation of concerns
Use meaningful naming conventions
Write production-quality code
Creativity Requirement
Add at least one custom feature of your own choice that showcases:
Creativity
Problem-solving ability
Engineering judgment
Explain why you built this feature and what problem it solves.
Deployment (Mandatory)
Deploy the application so it is publicly accessible
Handle environment variables securely
Submission Requirements
Please submit the following:
1. GitHub Repository
Public GitHub repository (or access granted)
Commit history should reflect your development process
2. Deployment Link (Mandatory)
Public URL for the deployed application
Frontend and backend should be reachable
3. Application Walkthrough Video (Mandatory)
Record a 3–4 minute video walkthrough of your application
The video should cover:
Overall application flow
Authentication and authorization
AI agent functionality
Custom/creative feature
High-level design decisions
Share video link
The video does not need to be polished — clarity matters more than video quality.
4. README (Mandatory)
Your README must include:
Project overview
Chosen tech stack (and justification if different)
Setup instructions (local and deployed)
High-level architecture explanation
Authentication and authorization approach
AI agent design and purpose
Explanation of your creative/custom feature
Key design decisions and trade-offs
Known limitations (if any)
Final Note to Candidate
This assessment is not about building the perfect application.
We are evaluating:
How you think
How you design systems
How you justify technical decisions
How you use creativity and AI responsibly
Strong opinions, backed by reasoning, are encouraged.
Surprise us!.
